text: Place the prepared naivedyam, fruit and coconut before the Devi.
Recite the naivedya mantra, Om Sri Gayatri Devyai namah, naivedyam nivedayami, and offer it.
After the naivedyam, offer a little water.
Then offer betel leaves and areca nuts: Om Sri Gayatri Devyai namah, thamboolam samarpayami.
